guitar.notes: Eddie Van Halen's homemade 'Frankenstrat' is among the most iconic guitars in rock history, extremely well documented.

tone.target: brown Marshall crunch with dry upper-mid bite
tone.profile: brown Marshall crunch with dry upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A high-gain, mid-focused signal chain utilizing a UK 45 or UK 50 style amp model, paired with a robust 4x12 cabinet to capture the classic Van Halen 'brown crunch' sound while maintaining clarity and bite.

rig.name: Van Halen - Hot For Teacher - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain hum and maintain tightness.
Provide initial grit and boost the upper-mids for bite.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is used as a general overdrive to simulate the Plexi/JCM crunch, though an actual Tube Screamer model would be ideal.

blocks.purpose: Add aggressive mid-range saturation and tighten the low end for 'brown crunch'.
blocks.gap: The RAT is excellent for biting mids, but a dedicated JCM/Plexi model would be more accurate.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British Marshall sound (Plexi/JCM era) with strong upper-mid presence.
Provide the classic British Marshall cabinet tone and necessary high-end punch.
Fine-tune the upper-mid bite and ensure the tone remains aggressive without sounding muddy.
Add minimal space and keep the tone dry and focused.
blocks.gap: A very subtle Room reverb is used to prevent the sound from being completely sterile, but kept low to maintain tightness.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and punch.

proposals.reason: Improve the bite and depth of the 4x12 cab tone.
